a: A filled DOT cluster with no fillcolor, color or bgcolor reads with no fill, where Graphviz fills it lightgrey
A reopened subgraph or cluster forgets the node and edge defaults its earlier opening set
Graph attributes a nested cluster inherits are warned as dropped where they are set
DOT writer never resets an inherited `penwidth`, so a nested box with no stroke width of its own reads back with its parent's
DOT `width`/`height` of zero or below are read as the node's size, where Graphviz holds them to its 0.01in minimum
b: DOT writer does not reset an outer cluster's `penwidth` in a nested cluster, so the inner one reads back with the outer's stroke width
DOT reader warns that root and plain-subgraph graph attributes were "dropped" while it still applies them to every cluster below
DOT reader gives a filled cluster with no color no fill, while a filled node with no color gets Graphviz's lightgrey
Diagram JSON reader validates a v1 page's `groups` list not at all, then renames it to `clusters` unchecked
